summary: Preinstall alternate-runtime dropper executes obfuscated payload via downloaded Bun
details: @servicetitan/datadog-rum@38.1.1 declares preinstall=`node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs is itself obfuscated (obfuscator.io-style hex-suffixed identifiers `_0x488df8`, `_0x52943e`, per-function property maps) and downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it via execFileSync against an adjacent 727KB single-line obfuscated file `math_init.js` (string-array rotation via a `WV8StW` push/shift rotator with a large mixed constant array; `// @bun @bun-cjs` header). math_init.js is never referenced by the package's dist/ code, so the payload is reachable only through the install lifecycle. A Datadog RUM configuration package has no legitimate reason to fetch a second JavaScript runtime and execute an opaque 727KB blob at install time; using Bun bypasses Node-based static analyzers and obfuscation of both the lifecycle wrapper and the payload conceals the executed behavior. The package name and scope also impersonate a legitimate ServiceTitan Datadog RUM library.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
